"It" the Album
is the fourth studio album by English
rock
band
Alien Sex Fiend
, released in October 1986 by
Anagram
Records.
Content
The album cover was painted by frontman Nik Fiend.
Release
The 1986 cassette version (
"It" the Cassette
) also included the band's full 1985 album
Maximum Security
.
The album was later reissued in CD format with three additional tracks and retitled
It (The CD)
.
